Separately inspect source checksum embedded in the physical metadata or line tables before/edit/restoration. Use full content hashes, separately ordered native member names and their contents.

Two diagnostic independently clean selected producer compilations with actual build argv, same logical paths, original + edited source and privately empty per-producer output and incremental namespaces. Keep raw status if an ordinary clean replay is not reproducible. Observe warnings, .d prerequisites, native source filename/paths, and signed source bytes.

If current derived metadata changes on the disabled source, retain new ordinary erroneous external diagnostic and a small proc-macro/source-text correctness witness when mapping is genuinely exercised. If no job is provably removable, preserve the exact boundary; no performance claims.
criterion: First reverse-applicable complete single-Rust-source patch in the audited 10,000-commit scan using filename structure and cfg(test) location only. Prefer identical file byte/line counts or within 128 bytes of module end. Neither applied candidate had that geometry.
disk: H2 only. Fresh typed stores or private copies under H2 home/tmpfs. Hold home >=25 GiB and tmpfs >=10 GiB, never wipe or overwrite preceding campaigns or H5. Use cp and targeted SHA256, no hardlinking shared release or mutable targets.
enabled_test_control: Compile test targets only. Inspect the real enabled test executable for the added test name. Do not run the test suite.

Compiler input is the normal library source in each Cargo mode. Record --test and actual -Z link-only independently. Keep Cargo messages, all physical compilers/linkers/absence and full changed file hashes per unit.
kind: Unscored H2 observational first occurrence, inline-disabled item in a normal production library. No product change.
